example.t: She managed to accomplish all her goals before the end of the year.
example.zh: 她在年底前成功实现了所有目标。

example.t: Do not hesitate to ask me if you have any questions about the task.
example.zh: 如果你对这项任务有任何疑问，请不要犹豫，直接问我。

example.t: We anticipate that prices will rise sharply over the next few months.
example.zh: 我们预计未来几个月价格将大幅上涨。

example.t: It is hard to comprehend why he made such a strange decision.
example.zh: 很难理解他为什么做出如此奇怪的决定。

example.t: Words alone cannot convey how grateful I am for your generous help.
example.zh: 单凭言语无法表达我对你慷慨帮助的感激之情。

example.t: The painting depicts a quiet village beside a wide and gentle river.
example.zh: 这幅画描绘了一个宽阔平缓的河流旁的宁静村庄。

example.t: The influence of the old market gradually diminished over the past decade.
example.zh: 过去十年里，这个旧市场的影响力逐渐减弱。

example.t: Loud music can easily distract students while they are trying to study.
example.zh: 吵闹的音乐很容易让学生在试图学习时分心。

example.t: The small town endured years of hardship before the economy finally improved.
example.zh: 这个小镇在最终经济好转前经受了多年的困苦。

example.t: Regular practice can greatly enhance your confidence when you speak in public.
example.zh: 经常练习能大大增强你当众演讲的自信。

example.t: Few students could grasp the main idea of such an abstract article.
example.zh: 很少有学生能理解这篇如此抽象的文章的主旨。

example.t: His silence seemed to imply that he did not agree with us.
example.zh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他并不同意我们。

example.t: Different readers may interpret the same short poem in completely different ways.
example.zh: 不同的读者可能对同一首短诗做出完全不同的解读。

example.t: You must always justify your decision with clear evidence and sound reasoning.
example.zh: 你必须始终用清晰的证据和可靠的推理来证明你的决定是正当的。

example.t: Many drivers neglect the basic checks that could prevent serious road accidents.
example.zh: 许多司机忽视了本可避免严重道路事故的基本检查。

example.t: Books and old papers occupied almost every corner of his small study.
example.zh: 书籍和旧文件几乎占据了他小书房里的每个角落。

example.t: Children often perceive the world quite differently from the way adults do.
example.zh: 孩子们对世界的看法常常与成年人大不相同。

example.t: She finally persuaded her parents to let her study art in Paris.
example.zh: 她终于说服父母让她去巴黎学艺术。

example.t: Experts predict that sea levels will continue to rise for many decades.
example.zh: 专家预测海平面将在未来数十年持续上升。

example.t: We should preserve these ancient buildings for the benefit of future generations.
example.zh: 我们应该为了后代的利益保护这些古建筑。

example.t: After graduation she decided to pursue a full-time career in medical research.
example.zh: 毕业后她决定从事医学研究的全职工作。

example.t: I cannot recall exactly when we first met, but it was autumn.
example.zh: 我记不清我们第一次见面的确切时间，但那是秋天。

example.t: These recent findings reinforce the view that good sleep strongly affects memory.
example.zh: 这些新发现强化了良好睡眠对记忆有强烈影响这一观点。

example.t: The survey revealed that most young workers felt unhappy with their pay.
example.zh: 这项调查显示，大多数年轻员工对自己的薪酬感到不满。

example.t: Many young graduates seek advice from experienced workers before choosing a career.
example.zh: 许多年轻毕业生在选择职业前会向有经验的员工寻求建议。

example.t: The teacher would not tolerate any form of cheating in her class.
example.zh: 这位老师绝不容忍课堂上任何形式的作弊。

example.t: Constant criticism can slowly undermine a child's confidence and love of learning.
example.zh: 不断的批评会慢慢削弱孩子的自信和对学习的热爱。

example.t: Journalists should always verify their sources before publishing such a serious story.
example.zh: 记者在发表如此严肃的报道前应始终核实消息来源。

example.t: The city decided to restrict traffic in the centre during busy hours.
example.zh: 该市决定在高峰时段限制市中心的交通。

example.t: The government suddenly imposed new heavy taxes on imported cars last autumn.
example.zh: 政府去年秋天突然对进口汽车征收了新的重税。

example.t: A lack of money remains the biggest obstacle to finishing this project.
example.zh: 资金短缺仍是完成这个项目的最大障碍。

example.t: Scientists still cannot fully explain this strange natural phenomenon in the desert.
example.zh: 科学家们仍然无法完全解释沙漠中这种奇怪的自然现象。

example.t: The experiment was designed to test whether the original hypothesis was truly correct.
example.zh: 该实验旨在检验最初的假设是否正确。

example.t: Travelling abroad gave her a fresh perspective on her own home culture.
example.zh: 出国旅行让她对自己的本土文化有了全新的视角。

example.t: Honesty is a basic principle that guides all of his business decisions.
example.zh: 诚实是指导他所有商业决策的基本原则。

example.t: For most young families, health and safety are clearly the highest priority.
example.zh: 对大多数年轻家庭来说，健康和安全显然是头等大事。

example.t: All visitors must follow the correct safety procedure before entering the laboratory.
example.zh: 所有访客在进入实验室前都必须遵守正确的安全程序。

example.t: A large proportion of the city population now regularly works from home.
example.zh: 这座城市很大一部分人口现在经常在家工作。

example.t: The small restaurant built a fine reputation for serving fresh local food.
example.zh: 这家小餐馆因供应新鲜的本地食物而赢得了良好声誉。

example.t: The company completely changed its marketing strategy after sales fell last year.
example.zh: 去年销量下滑后，这家公司彻底改变了营销策略。

example.t: Many young people have a tendency to spend too much time online.
example.zh: 许多年轻人有花太多时间上网的倾向。

example.t: Climate change now poses a serious threat to many low-lying island nations.
example.zh: 气候变化如今对许多低洼岛国构成严重威胁。

example.t: The government spends a great deal of public money on child welfare.
example.zh: 政府在儿童福利上投入了大量公共资金。

example.t: Cost is only one aspect of the problem that we must consider.
example.zh: 成本只是我们必须考虑的问题的一个方面。

example.t: Price is not the only criterion for choosing a good reliable laptop.
example.zh: 价格并不是选择一台好而可靠笔记本电脑的唯一标准。

example.t: Working parents often face a serious dilemma between career and family time.
example.zh: 在职父母常常面临事业与家庭时间之间的严重两难困境。

example.t: Tax cuts provided a strong incentive for people to buy electric cars.
example.zh: 减税为人们购买电动汽车提供了强有力的激励。

example.t: Her new book offers fresh insight into how children actually learn languages.
example.zh: 她的新书为儿童实际如何学习语言提供了全新见解。

example.t: Working from home has now become the norm in many modern companies.
example.zh: 在家工作如今已成为许多现代公司的常态。

example.t: The party has taken a firm stance against any higher fuel taxes.
example.zh: 该党对任何提高燃油税的做法都采取了坚定立场。

example.t: She made remarkable progress in English during only six short months of study.
example.zh: 她仅在六个月的短暂学习期间，英语就取得了显著进步。

example.t: He was reluctant to leave his old job for a higher salary.
example.zh: 他不愿意为更高的薪水而离开原来的工作。

example.t: The evidence was simply not sufficient to prove that he was guilty.
example.zh: 这些证据根本不足以证明他有罪。

example.t: Elderly people are especially vulnerable to illness during the very cold winter months.
example.zh: 老年人在极其寒冷的冬季特别容易生病。

example.t: His answer was so ambiguous that nobody really knew what he meant.
example.zh: 他的回答如此含糊，以致没有人真正知道他想表达什么。

example.t: She is a highly competent manager who never once missed a deadline.
example.zh: 她是一位非常能干的经理，从未错过任何一次截止日期。

example.t: The city is home to people from many diverse cultural and religious backgrounds.
example.zh: 这座城市是许多来自不同文化和宗教背景的人们的家园。

example.t: The teacher gave explicit instructions about how to write the final essay.
example.zh: 老师就如何撰写这篇期末论文给出了明确的指示。

example.t: It is not financially feasible for us to build a new library.
example.zh: 对我们来说，新建一座图书馆在财务上并不可行。

example.t: She showed genuine concern for the many students who were still struggling.
example.zh: 她对许多仍在挣扎的学生表现出真诚的关心。

example.t: Some conflict is inevitable when people work closely together for many years.
example.zh: 当人们多年来紧密合作时，一些冲突是不可避免的。

example.t: The heat in the desert was so intense that we could hardly breathe.
example.zh: 沙漠中的酷热如此强烈，我们几乎无法呼吸。

example.t: Clean drinking water is becoming scarce in many parts of the world.
example.zh: 在世界许多地方，清洁的饮用水正变得稀缺。

example.t: Doctors say the patient's condition has remained stable throughout the whole night.
example.zh: 医生说病人的病情整夜保持稳定。

example.t: There is a subtle difference between the two words in this context.
example.zh: 在这个语境中，这两个词之间存在微妙的差别。

example.t: Solar power has become a viable alternative to burning coal and gas.
example.zh: 太阳能已成为替代燃煤和燃气的一种可行选择。

example.t: There is widespread concern about the effects of social media on teens.
example.zh: 人们对社交媒体对青少年的影响普遍感到担忧。

example.t: The war had a profound effect on the whole generation of writers.
example.zh: 那场战争对这一整代作家产生了深远的影响。

example.t: Her parents are quite conservative about how late she may stay out.
example.zh: 她父母对她可以在外面待到多晚相当保守。

example.t: The new rules seemed completely arbitrary and were very hard to justify.
example.zh: 这些新规定似乎完全武断，很难证明其合理性。

example.t: The plan is far too expensive; moreover, it will take years to finish.
example.zh: 这个计划太昂贵了；而且，它需要数年才能完成。

example.t: The task was extremely difficult; nevertheless, the team finished it on time.
example.zh: 这项任务极其困难；尽管如此，团队还是按时完成了。

example.t: She trained hard every single day, thereby improving her speed and strength.
example.zh: 她每天刻苦训练，从而提高了速度和力量。

example.t: The two systems are fundamentally different in the way that they work.
example.zh: 这两个系统在工作方式上有着根本的不同。

example.t: The two products are virtually identical, except for the small price tag.
example.zh: 这两个产品几乎完全相同，只是价格标签不同。

example.t: He was merely trying to help you, so please do not blame him.
example.zh: 他只不过是想帮你，所以请不要责怪他。

example.t: The road was flooded; hence, we had to take a longer route.
example.zh: 道路被水淹了；因此，我们不得不走一条更长的路线。

example.t: She is undoubtedly one of the best students in our whole class.
example.zh: 她无疑是我们全班最优秀的学生之一。

example.t: He rarely speaks in public because he is afraid of making mistakes.
example.zh: 他很少在公众场合讲话，因为他害怕犯错。

example.t: The old train arrived at precisely eight o'clock every morning without fail.
example.zh: 这列旧火车每天早上都分秒不差地在八点整到达。

example.t: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor football match went ahead as planned.
example.zh: 尽管下着大雨，这场户外足球赛还是按计划进行了。

example.t: The festival is celebrated throughout the whole country with music and dancing.
example.zh: 全国上下都通过音乐和舞蹈来庆祝这个节日。

example.t: She asked several detailed questions regarding the new rules on sick leave.
example.zh: 她就病假新规提出了几个详细的问题。

example.t: The total cost of the repairs was far beyond what we had expected.
example.zh: 维修的总费用远远超出了我们的预期。

example.t: You must hand in the full report within three working days from now.
example.zh: 你必须在从现在起三个工作日内提交完整报告。

example.t: Some students really enjoy group work, whereas others prefer to study alone.
example.zh: 有些学生真的很喜欢小组合作，而另一些则更喜欢独自学习。

example.t: We will cancel the picnic unless the weather improves by early tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 除非明天一早天气好转，否则我们将取消野餐。

example.t: You may borrow my old car provided that you drive very carefully.
example.zh: 只要你开得非常小心，就可以借用我的旧车。

example.t: The plan was finally accepted, albeit with several important changes to it.
example.zh: 该计划最终被接受了，尽管做了几处重要修改。

example.t: I am still not sure whether he will agree to join our team.
example.zh: 我仍然不确定他是否会同意加入我们的团队。

example.t: In terms of price, this model is clearly better than the other one.
example.zh: 就价格而言，这款机型明显比另一款更好。

example.t: He missed the last bus; as a result, he had to walk home.
example.zh: 他错过了末班车；结果，他不得不步行回家。

example.t: He is not lazy at all; on the contrary, he works extremely hard.
example.zh: 他一点也不懒；恰恰相反，他工作极其努力。

example.t: In sharp contrast, the second group showed almost no improvement at all.
example.zh: 与之形成鲜明对比的是，第二组几乎没有表现出任何进步。

example.t: Learning a foreign language well is by no means an easy task.
example.zh: 学好一门外语绝不是一件容易的事。

example.t: We must take into account the total cost before making a final decision.
example.zh: 在做出最终决定前，我们必须考虑到总成本。

example.t: Genes play an important role in shaping a person's character and health.
example.zh: 基因在塑造一个人的性格和健康方面起着重要作用。

example.t: Please bear in mind that the final deadline cannot be extended again.
example.zh: 请记住，最终截止日期不能再延长了。

example.t: Exercising regularly now will greatly benefit your health in the long run.
example.zh: 现在经常锻炼，从长远来看对你的健康有益。

example.t: He finally achieved success at the expense of his health and family.
example.zh: 他最终以牺牲健康和家庭为代价换来了成功。
